text: What if you had a mantis shrimp's punch?
This shrimp is about ten centimeters long.
Its club swings at 80 kilometers per hour.
Over ten thousand G's of acceleration.
Fighter pilots black out at around nine.
The whole strike is over in milliseconds.
It hits with up to 1,500 newtons.
Water behind the club rips into bubbles.
They collapse with a flash of light.
Thousands of degrees, for an instant.
So every target gets hit twice.
It can even crack aquarium glass.
Now give that punch to you.
Scaled to you? About 100 cars of force!
One tap could split a boulder in half.
Your fist would need armor like its club.
So... what would you punch first?
